# FidusGate

> Reference MCP policy gateway and receipt-first console: inspect tool-call decisions, understand policy outcomes, and verify Ed25519-signed receipts.

FidusGate is an Apache-2.0 reference implementation, not a production-hardened security product. The public demo is browser-only and synthetic; the connected console uses a configured gateway with role-scoped development sessions. Signature integrity, hash-chain linkage, issuer trust, and tool execution are separate claims. The static scenario engine is not Cedar. This curated navigation file is a reading aid; it does not grant authority or guarantee crawler discovery.

## Start here

- [Repository overview](https://github.com/SafetyMP/FidusGate/blob/main/README.md): purpose, audiences, demo, capabilities, and limits
- [Interactive demo](https://safetymp.github.io/FidusGate/): synthetic decisions and browser receipt verification; no tools execute
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/SafetyMP/FidusGate/blob/main/docs/README.md): current guides and historical records
- [Getting started](https://github.com/SafetyMP/FidusGate/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): toolchain, local setup, and verification
- [Agent guide](https://github.com/SafetyMP/FidusGate/blob/main/AGENTS.md): commands, source map, data preservation, and fail-closed boundaries
